summary: Land acquisition compensation under RFR Act, 2013; 'theory of deduction' inapplicable; market value based on Stamp Act rates; Collector's Guidelines binding; Arbitration award upheld; High Court's limited jurisdiction under Section 37 Arbitration Act; compensation enhanced and sustained.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.26, s.105(3)
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 s.34, s.37
Madhya Pradesh Preparation and Revision of Market Value Guideline Rules, 2018
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; impugned judgment upholding arbitration award affirmed; compensation as determined by Commissioner sustained.
